title: PDF Reader & Scanner
short_description: Read, search, scan and sign PDFs on your phone.

guides.title: How to Make a Scanned PDF Searchable on Android
guides.description: Why a scanned PDF cannot be searched, how OCR adds a hidden text layer, and how to turn a scan into a searchable PDF on your phone.

guides.title: Open a Password-Protected PDF on Android
guides.description: Why a PDF asks for a password, which Android versions can open it, what to do when it fails, and the difference between the two PDF passwords.

guides.title: How to Sign a PDF on Android With Your Finger
guides.description: Draw your signature on your phone, place it on a PDF, resize it and save a signed copy. Includes a short note on when a drawn signature is accepted.
